In the case of conflicting laws or state sovereignty, the Supreme Court plays a crucial role in resolving such disputes through its power of judicial review. It is their responsibility to determine whether a state law violates the Constitution. However, it is important to remember that the Supreme Court's decisions are not always absolute. They are merely interpretations of the Constitution, subject to the possibility of being overturned by future decisions. So, while we must respect the legal process and the authority of the courts, we must also remain vigilant and engaged in the political process to ensure that our laws and institutions remain consistent and effective in serving the best interests of society.
